description: The signed-in couple's own wedding registry on Zola: change the quantity that the couple asks for, for 1 product of the Zola shop on the registry. Get the registry_item_id from zola_search_my_registry_items. The quantity cannot go below the number that guests bought. A group gift has a goal, not a quantity: the couple changes it on zola.com. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

quantity.description: The new quantity that the couple asks for. Not below the number that guests bought

registry_item_id.description: The registry_item_id of a Zola product from zola_search_my_registry_items

sku_id.description: The sku_id of the item, to make sure that the item is this product

name: zola_update_my_registry_product

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a quantity change on the registry of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the registry

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_update_my_registry_product with the same arguments, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

records.description: The registry items with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_search_my_registry_items gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Update My Registry Product
